provider.description: Australian eToro entity providing access to a multi-asset investment platform. Regulated financial products and non-leveraged cryptoassets have different regulatory treatment in Australia.

offering.name: eToro Share Trading
offering.description: eToro's Australian stock and ETF investing service. Non-leveraged long stock/ETF positions are provided through the eToro Service managed investment scheme; leveraged positions are CFDs and are outside this share-trading offering.

markets.notes: Australian stocks are available through eToro's Australian offering.
